controller: tools/honda-readonly-preflight/comprehensive_controller.py; ordinary ADB only; exact owner state confirmations, one-use review-bound authorization, fixed allowlist, and 158400512-byte combined stdout/stderr session limit
host: existing authorized Mac; offline preparation only
target: 2018 Honda Clarity PHEV Touring, MY16ADA; owner privately verifies exact unit and already-authorized ADB serial; never persist serial publicly.

execution_bounds_proposal.raw_evidence_destination: new host-only directory outside Git, mode 0700; files mode 0600
execution_bounds_proposal.evidence_integrity: SHA-256 per artifact plus immutable source/profile/manifest binding

per_command_bounds.enforced_by: FixedAdb byte cap includes its bounded failure marker; SessionOutputBudget accounts stdout+stderr across all phases before persistence. A total-bound violation aborts and cannot produce campaign success.

execution_bounds_proposal.process_placeholder_binding: Only a separately justified Phase 3 privileged read may substitute a validated PID as one argv element. Before/after that exact read, Revalidate all four identity facts: bind PID to stat start-time ticks, cmdline /system/bin/jmcs, root UID/GID, and exe symlink /system/bin/jmcs. Ordinary observations use ps PID continuity and make no start-time claim.
execution_bounds_proposal.command_form: Every listed command is a fixed argv vector; no shell string executor, command concatenation, or caller-provided argv is permitted.

global_stop_conditions: target or process identity mismatch, PID/start-time change, or authorization mismatch

unexpected vehicle warning including low-voltage/battery or charging-system warning, READY indicator, engine start, abnormal power/battery behavior, unexpected dimming/flicker/reset, or loss of safe Park/outdoor conditions
center display, cluster, Navigation, CarPlay, HondaHack, or audio behavior outside the specifically approved expected state

ADB transport error, permission denial from a required operation, unsupported required command, timeout, output limit, or controller exception; optional fixed graphics/network reads reported absent or denied, and fixed OEM packages reported absent, are recorded once without retry
source/profile/manifest hash mismatch, incomplete command ledger, or evidence integrity/privacy failure
any command or action not enumerated in the reviewed phase profile
required_conditions_for_any_future_run: separate exact owner authorization for the selected ordinary ADB and owner-operated stock CarPlay phases
current exact candidate source/profile/source-lock review packet bound to the candidate commit

before ON, finish host preflight, private storage checks, controller launch, and authorization validation without target ADB commands; then use power mode ON, READY absent, engine not running, and start a manual 50-minute timer that includes all work through normal power-off
owner records the exact already-authorized ADB transport privately and attests it is independent of the iPhone/CarPlay data path and shared hub
owner physically present; factory display, cluster, Navigation, warning behavior, and audio normal
one already-authorized ADB endpoint; no scan, endpoint fallback, setting change, or escalation
independent review of fixed ADB commands, API-17 compatibility assumptions, resource accounting, failure handling, privacy, and restoration
qualified vehicle-safety review before any operation affecting factory display or warnings

owner_actions: confirm stationary outdoors, Park, parking brake engaged, power mode ON, READY absent, engine not running; start the manual 50-minute timer now and include all work through normal power-off
confirm the existing authorized ADB transport is independent of the iPhone/CarPlay data path and any shared hub; attest and describe it in the private authorization
confirm owner present and normal factory warning/display/cluster/Navigation/audio state
record iPhone and existing debugging state without changing either
identify normal shutdown and previously verified backup/recovery records
phases.stop: Any abnormal condition or missing prerequisite; no ADB.

owner_actions: confirm the exact physical Honda identity against the owner-private vehicle reference and verify its existing authorized ADB serial
confirm the endpoint is already authorized; do not enumerate devices, scan, change transport, use adb root, or change settings
confirm the owner-only local evidence directory, free capacity, mode 0700, files mode 0600, and cloud sync disabled
review the fixed target properties, evidence question, current source/profile/manifest pins, stop conditions, and recovery prerequisites
phases.stop: Any target/process mismatch, permission denial from a required identity/service operation, unsupported required API17 command, timeout, output limit, warning, transport error, or abnormal factory behavior. A fixed package absence or optional graphics/network read denial/absence is recorded once and does not trigger retry or escalation.
phases.identity_revalidation: Verify the exact API-17 target properties, ordinary shell UID/GID, and exactly one jmcs PID before any later observation. Start-time and executable identity are reserved for the blocked privileged Phase 3 method.

baseline_inventory.purpose: Capture installed factory package metadata, APK paths, and Android service inventory once before state transitions. A single bounded ls /sys/class/graphics reports exposed graphics node names if present; it is inventory only and not a framebuffer access test.
baseline_inventory.expected_answers: Package presence/version/code path and service declarations; one package APK path per package; framework service inventory. Graphics class node names where exposed.
baseline_inventory.privacy: OEM build/package metadata remains in the private run archive.

phases.access_decision: Step 40E4 found no currently justifiable privileged path. Owner approval alone is insufficient; no live su argv is proposed.
required_evidence_to_reconsider: new offline evidence justifying a least-impact access method
independent review of SuperSU prompts, logs, daemon effects, and recovery consequences
separate exact owner approval after the above review
offline_actions: review archived SuperSU provenance, exact hash/mode, prompts, logs, daemon behavior, and recovery implications
do not install, update, configure, or replace the existing root mechanism
phases.known_side_effect: SuperSU invocation may create logs or alter daemon/authorization state; zero-write behavior is not established.
phases.stop: No live privileged operation under the current finding. No adb root or fallback.

phases.access_decision: No live procfs access is proposed until Phase 2 reconsideration criteria are met and independently reviewed.
required_observations_if_reconsidered: PID and process start-time ticks before and after bounded metadata reads
maps and smaps for mappings, protections, and load-bias inputs
FD symlink inode identities and same-phase socket tables for exact inode joins
only explicitly approved /proc/net tables; no process memory, credentials, environment, keys, or secrets
phases.process_identity_revalidation: Re-read stat/cmdline/status before and after; compare PID plus start-time ticks.
phases.stop: Any permission denial, identity change, malformed output, non-enumerated path, unexpected side effect, timeout, or limit.

phases.identity_revalidation: At each steady state, the listed unprivileged ps command requires exactly one jmcs row and the same PID across the phase. This does not establish process start time, cmdline, UID/GID, or executable identity; those observations require the separately blocked privileged metadata method.
owner_actions: Connect stock Type110 CarPlay and wait for a stable normal state.
Select factory Navigation, deselect it, then reselect it using normal controls.
Disconnect CarPlay using its normal owner-operated flow.
Reconnect stock CarPlay and wait for a stable normal state.
After reconnection, select Navigation and then deselect it using normal controls.
Disconnect CarPlay for the final time.
phases.network_scope: Read-only global socket tables and usb0 operstate at each stable state. Never attribute global rows to jmcs without an exact same-snapshot FD/socket inode join. No packet capture, socket probe, mutation, retry, or privilege escalation.
phases.stop: Any global stop condition, abnormal Type110 display/audio/call/warning behavior, receiver identity change, or unexpected transport state.
phases.log_collection_purpose: One bounded 500-line log snapshot after each owner-confirmed state; compare event timing offline. Raw logs remain private. Absence of /info or SETUP text means NOT_OBSERVED and never implies Type111 support.
phases.process_identity_revalidation: At each stable state require exactly one jmcs PID and the same PID as the approved baseline. This unprivileged check does not establish start-time or executable identity; those require the blocked Phase 3 method.
phases.comparative_purpose: Compare process PID, ActivityManager activity/service records, logical display, WindowManager, SurfaceFlinger layers, global network tables, usb0 operstate and bounded recent log records across all ten owner-confirmed states. These are process/window/layer lifetime proxies only; they do not expose ViewRoot ownership, physical pixels, warning precedence, or decoded Type111 events. Global socket rows are not jmcs-owned without same-snapshot FD-to-inode correlation.
phases.activity_manager_scope: dumpsys activity activities/services may identify resumed activities, service records and component/process relationships; they do not expose the full View hierarchy or Surface producer ownership.
phases.owner_confirmation_rule: Every listed stable state requires one explicit READY confirmation before any state commands. The owner watches for abnormal factory behavior during the snapshot and interrupts to STOP if observed; after STOP no further vehicle command is issued.
phases.qualified_vehicle_safety_review: Required before the ordinary Type110/Navigation transition campaign; review the exact fixed command set and stationary owner operation.

phases.authorization_status: NORMAL_COMPLETION_ONLY; ABORT PATH IS HOST ONLY
owner_checks: vehicle remains stationary in Park and READY absent
phases.shared_adb_server: Do not stop or inspect a shared server without a reviewed host-only reason; report uncertainty if it remains unknown.
phases.abort_path: Host-only controller/capture cleanup. No additional ADB or other vehicle command after an abort unless a new exact recovery action is independently reviewed and authorized.
phases.stop: Any global stop condition or restoration uncertainty requires owner attention; no additional vehicle command after abort and no remote power-off.
phases.process_identity_revalidation: Exactly one jmcs row and PID continuity from baseline; ordinary shell does not establish start-time, cmdline, UID/GID, or executable identity.
owner_actions: Restore the owner-defined normal factory state using ordinary controls after the final disconnect.
Confirm CarPlay disconnected and factory Navigation, center display, cluster, audio, and warnings are normal.
Confirm host archive finalization; then power down normally using factory controls.
phases.comparative_purpose: Compare the owner-confirmed factory restoration snapshot against the disconnected baseline, including process, activity/service, display/window/layer, network, usb0 and bounded log results.
phases.network_scope: Read-only global socket tables and usb0 operstate for restoration comparison; no jmcs ownership claim without FD-to-inode join.
phases.log_collection_purpose: One bounded log snapshot for restoration comparison; raw logs remain private.

post_session_instrumentation.authorization: HondaHack observation, privileged access, receiver hooks, and active Type111 instrumentation remain excluded and require separate proposal, exact signal, independent technical/security review, qualified vehicle-safety review where applicable, owner approval, and restoration evidence.
